zone_themes.Z1: Terraced village and garden welcome: readable, friendly field ecology.
zone_themes.Z2: Open plains, ponds, meadow motion, insects and small water-edge life.
zone_themes.Z3: Cave and ore ecology: goblin, fungus, stone and subterranean craft.
zone_themes.Z4: Mist forest: sprites, woodland animals, vines, moss and flowers.
zone_themes.Z5: Tribal frontier and clay camp: herd, drum, banner and campfire motifs.
zone_themes.Z6: Sky-and-fire dragon valley: wyverns, lava, crystal and aerial motion.
zone_themes.Z7: Tower/library alchemy: spellcraft, constructs, observatory and arcane familiars.
zone_themes.Z8: Fortified frontier under pressure: gates, siege forms, scouts and armor.
zone_themes.Z9: Mythic storm and celestial weather: aurora, stars, thunder and sky fauna.
zone_themes.Z10: Ancient relic finale: temple, timeworn stone, gates, ruins and old roots.

owner_decision_packet.rationale: Serpent/crawler ecology has a plausible cave adjacency, but the existing ART002 Z6 wind/sky assignment is a materially competing record.
Construct identity has a plausible ancient-relic adjacency, but the existing ART002 Z7 tower-magic assignment is a materially competing record.
Beetle/crawler identity can fit early field ecology, but the existing ART002 Z8 siege/frontier assignment is a materially competing record.
Bat identity can fit the open-land/cave edge ecology, but the existing ART002 Z8 scout/frontier assignment is a materially competing record.
Crab/water-edge identity can fit the early puddle ecology, but the existing ART002 Z8 moat/fortification assignment is a materially competing record.
Small serpent silhouette and luminous color could support readable early content, but the existing ART002 Z9 aurora/mythic assignment is a materially competing record.
A fast biped silhouette can add playful early variety, but the existing ART002 Z9 orbit/mythic assignment is a materially competing record.
Small insect silhouette can support early readability, but the existing ART002 Z9 eclipse/mythic assignment is a materially competing record.
Blob identity can support readable early variety, but the existing ART002 Z9 firmament/mythic assignment is a materially competing record.
